mapper.select: SELECT * FROM online_regression_jobs WHERE run_id = #{runId} ORDER BY created_at ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO online_regression_jobs (id, run_id, job_key, app_id, app_name, device_id, device_name, device_platform, endpoint, status, progress, current_step_label, account_phone, error_message, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{runId}, #{jobKey}, #{appId}, #{appName}, #{deviceId}, #{deviceName}, #{devicePlatform}, #{endpoint}, #{status}, #{progress}, #{currentStepLabel}, #{accountPhone}, #{errorMessage}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE online_regression_jobs SET status = #{status}, progress = #{progress}, current_step_label = #{currentStepLabel}, account_phone = #{accountPhone}, error_message = #{errorMessage}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id}
